messages.game.2277a46be42b036c: After getting off the plane, next come mountains of 砂 (sand). ...Every time the wind blows, footprints disappear.
messages.game.1a53326e6ca58e5d: Kanji are missing from the signpost, so we don't know the road that 延 (stretches) 沿 (along) the sea.
messages.game.13ff2fd019d0a8a6: The 「一望」 and 「千里」 from 一望千里 (a sweeping view for a thousand ri) are running wild, too. Let's calm everyone down so we can read the signpost.
messages.game.e9c7131f32cf06f7: ...We read it! We follow the road that 延 (stretches) 沿 (along) the sea. Even if footprints vanish into the 砂 (sand), with this we won't get lost.
messages.game.057c4b3a7c5cc894: 一望千里 means being able to survey everything far into the distance at a glance. ...It's blue all the way out past the sea.
messages.game.41ca6122e52cda75: That child could be anywhere. ...Where should we look? First, let's head to the town at the end of this road.
messages.game.f2de33112d551b9a: ...The 「諸」 and 「郷」 returned to the name tags. Now we know the seats for the gods of the various 諸国 (provinces/lands).
messages.game.4464acee430f6563: 家内安全 is a phrase wishing that every member of the family can live free of misfortune.
messages.game.fc5fe95e843451ae: ...How can we meet that child who could be anywhere? Let's go west.
messages.game.d92fce9f9884615e: It's a 劇 (play) where Momotaro goes off to defeat the ogres who are the 敵 (enemies). It starts soon.
messages.game.cd7aa34a67137c58: But the 「敵」 (enemy) kanji in the script has gone wild, so the ogre actor won't come out.
messages.game.97263032278ebf73: The 「油断」 and 「大敵」 from 油断大敵 (carelessness is a great enemy) are running wild at the theater entrance, too. Let's calm everyone down and start the 劇 (play).
messages.game.9197de41829cf0d5: ...The 「敵」 (enemy) is back in the script! The ogre actor came out, too, and the rest of the 劇 (play) has begun.
messages.game.35b9d96132e170d2: 油断大敵 is a phrase meaning that if you let your guard down, you'll fail. Momotaro is steeling himself, too.
messages.game.a0c983400e02a206: ...Without a 「敵」 (enemy), the story doesn't move forward. Going off to defeat the bad guys... That's how stories progress, isn't it.
messages.game.2314653cfa5b4cb6: A town lined with storehouses with white walls. Here, they 染 (dye) threads and make cloth, don't they.
messages.game.3fd0bb0544e927d8: But kanji are missing from the card with the 染 (dyeing) instructions, and the 絹 (silk) threads keep coming out the wrong colors.
messages.game.388b74391858d945: The 「創意」 and 「工夫」 from 創意工夫 (originality and ingenuity) are running wild, too. Let's calm everyone down and 染 (dye) the 絹 (silk) just as the card says.
messages.game.bb0e93c2280cbfde: ...We read the card! Now we know the order and timing for 染 (dyeing) the threads, and the 絹 (silk) colors all matched.
messages.game.6a17b4622722eaea: 創意工夫 means turning ideas over in your mind to find a good method. Clever ideas for making colors have been passed down, too.
messages.game.80a647717cd4ecb9: Sewing the cloth with a 「針」 (needle), the 絹 (silk) garments take shape. When you can read the kanji, the town's crafts carry on to the next step.
messages.game.7cf69cecb30b804a: A great torii gate standing in the sea. Today is the day to 納 (offer) music and dance to the shrine.
messages.game.2ff6af39a395762c: But kanji are missing from the 「巻」 (scroll) for 奏 (performing) the piece, so we don't know which notes to play.
messages.game.bc03c3e54e4a4d75: The 「天下」 and 「一品」 from 天下一品 (the finest under heaven) are running wild, too. Let's calm everyone down and begin the music and dance.
messages.game.f627df21df21c988: ...We read the 「巻」 (scroll)! When the flute 奏 (played) the piece, the dance began.
messages.game.7085cb5bf8ca9cab: 天下一品 means the very best in the world. The dance with the sea behind it is splendid, too.
messages.game.e504ede5276cdb2b: Keeping time with the flute, they 納 (offer) the dance to the gods. A tune from long ago is still handed down here today.
messages.game.fdb54a6cf93fcd0c: ...The kanji for 「忘れない」 (don't forget) returned to the stone. Even people who come here read it slowly.
messages.game.cb2d1366b1d0b717: 共存共栄 means living together and prospering together.
messages.game.62c0ca464017d180: That child said this: "I knew everything from the start."
messages.game.741973e02bcdb2b3: So there's a big 「穴」 (hole) under the ground. Let's go 探検 (exploring) inside.
messages.game.3dd8311cb6468b77: Huh? The 「裏」 (back/other side) kanji is missing from the map, so we don't know the way to the exit.
messages.game.acb8e1ff4cd400a6: The 「秘密」 and 「基地」 from 秘密基地 (secret base) are running wild, too. Let's rescue the kanji and try reading the 「裏」 (back) of the map.
messages.game.2eba2a15504f7ebc: ...We read the 「裏」 (back) of the map! Now we know the route that leads to the exit.
messages.game.855440fbd10fddbb: A 秘密基地 (secret base) is a place kept hidden so people won't know about it. It seems like there might be such a place in these underground caverns, too.
messages.game.2f5f44e339391a9e: It stretches out this much where you can't see it. Reading the map makes you want to 探検 (explore) even more, doesn't it.
messages.game.2eead78a1e1f65f8: The 「券」 (ticket) kanji is back. ...A meal ticket. We just hand this 券 (ticket) to the person at the stall.
messages.game.08ae9cce3b861e94: 千客万来 means countless customers coming one after another. People are gathering toward the light of the food stalls.
messages.game.0b72923b3cc6aa3a: I already read that stall's sign over there, too. ...Everyone looks like they're having fun.
messages.game.6c10f78a77aa1985: 博学多才 means knowing many things and being able to do all sorts of things.
messages.game.e476c7d818153e41: That child said this: "Why come to learn something you already know?"
messages.game.099bad7ce0dd50da: So this is where a village stood long ago. The kanji are 刻 (carved) into the guide stones made by people of today.
messages.game.1c9802455562e246: Huh? The 「穀」 (grain) kanji has gone wild, so we can't read the description of the storehouse.
messages.game.1727d69fcb5dffe4: What did they keep in that storehouse, I wonder? Let's rescue the 「穀」 (grain) kanji and try reading the guide.
messages.game.b0e4ecb206845e13: We read it! "A storehouse for 穀物 (grain)." 穀物 means rice, wheat, and the like.
messages.game.8b79708283026e27: So they stored rice and wheat here. The kanji 刻 (carved) into the stone reveal what life was like long ago.
messages.game.6308b9a63eb82950: 古代文明 (ancient civilization) refers to the ways of life and culture created by people in the distant past. ...What kind of person used this storehouse, I wonder.
messages.game.7281c66852527de3: Thank you. Now we can read 「胃」 (stomach), 「腸」 (intestines), and 「肺」 (lungs). Now we can point at the diagram and talk about the body.
messages.game.4a2c9f4a31069e73: 無病息災 means living healthy and vigorous, without sickness. ...I hope everyone can stay in good health.
messages.game.e8fbc6363d06d7f0: That child said this: "If you just asked me, you'd know right away."
messages.game.f95fcbd043dc0c6a: This is a port where goods are traded with distant lands. A letter has arrived by ship, too.
messages.game.8ba5cc0551b610f7: The kanji on the card that 訳 (translates) the letter into Japanese have gone wild, so we can't read where it should be delivered.
messages.game.bd5b222841dfc6a5: Who did they want this to reach, all the way across the sea? Let's rescue the kanji and try reading the card.
messages.game.2ab5071eac57bf70: We read it! It says, "Please deliver this book to the medical clinic."
messages.game.ba1d844ada47022d: So the book reaches the doctor from earlier. When you 訳 (translate) words, even the feelings of someone in a distant land get through.
messages.game.53627937b2bd322f: 半信半疑 means being half belief and half doubt, with each feeling taking up half.
messages.game.dbbe19d3b4fefa1e: What a big castle. In front of the stone wall, the workers doing the repairs are troubled.
messages.game.f1476b1a4fc64cb6: The kanji on the diagram for 補修 (repairing) the stone wall have gone wild, so they can't read which part to fix.
messages.game.2c6bcb5ca826b84f: Let's rescue the kanji and try reading the diagram. There might be a clue for dividing up the work.
messages.game.b085b008720483ee: We read it! It says, "補修 (repair) the stone wall to the right of the gate." Now they know which part to fix.
messages.game.ac2f5ce68b6a4759: The diagram has the 「担当」 (person in charge) names, too. Once they know who takes which section, they can start the work.
messages.game.473925490d7d4e4d: 一国一城 means one country and one castle. It's also used to mean having a place of one's own.
messages.game.3128d0deee0a2fec: We read it! "No entry beyond this point due to controlled grass burning." Let's play in the open area before the sign.
messages.game.8db3c1682be642f9: 広大無辺 means spreading out endlessly, with no edge. One more time, under the big sky.
messages.game.65aa13dbb3fb2869: That child said this: "I know everything. ...But I can't see the reason why that child laughs."
messages.game.33cdbcc5cb40522c: We read it! Now we know how long to steam the egg. Let's leave it to the person at the shop and wait for it to be ready.
messages.game.2537cb74d894a9c4: 元気回復 means getting your energy back. After a little rest, let's press on.
messages.game.fae24f587285e1d0: That child said this: "...Strange. I should know this, but I don't understand."
messages.game.e74adbb07e7096c9: We read it! Next comes the scene where the door opens. Now the kagura dance can go on.
messages.game.09d6b9a767b7dc57: 天地創造 means the creation of heaven and earth, of the world. It appears in stories passed down by people of long ago, too.
messages.game.c7e9fe0d333734db: That child said, 'I know what fun means. ...But I don't understand it.'
messages.game.3a5a1fa7c35fb0b4: We read it! The forecast says ash will fall on this town tomorrow, too. We can hang the laundry to dry indoors.
messages.game.8b3058f36ba30356: 日常生活 means everyday life. When you can read the kanji, you can prepare for tomorrow, too.
messages.game.0581bac083687d06: A message has come from another Mana. ...It says kanji are running wild all over the place.
messages.game.a10c000fc6f442a9: ...We read it. That child's eyes went wide. "How did you figure that out?"
messages.game.538a16e080c727d9: That child said this: "I want to know something I don't know."
messages.game.1874748c035533f6: 'Come to the last island in the south,' they said. ...They want to find out a little more about whether it's really fun.
messages.game.6197733003f13dea: Saying that, the child vanished from sight. ...Let's keep traveling, too.
messages.game.f8453281ceeac668: The teachers are helping, too. ...Everyone is protecting the towns they're in now.
messages.game.47f31d66129d4bca: This is the last town. Sugarcane fields spread out near Shuri Castle.
messages.game.23d667226a9bbb6d: Let's make sure everyone can read this town's kanji, too.
messages.game.73bc80ef9fb4863f: A great sacred rope. This is a grand shrine in Izumo.
messages.game.b87376961f20c5f0: They say that in October, all the gods of Japan gather here in Izumo.
messages.game.830c080c241cd37e: But kanji are missing from the gods' name tags. We can't match their seats to their home regions. 諸 means various, and 郷 means home region.
messages.game.2f2ba71c09ee3087: 家内 and 安全 are running wild too. Together, 家内安全 means safety at home. Let's calm them all so everyone can find their seat.
messages.game.c0073395b7032acb: …Even gods can only be in one place at a time, you see. That's why they gather here.
messages.game.e8b783578acbdad7: So many paper cranes. …This is a place for peace.
messages.game.f9bb5cf2d69bc7c8: Mana. …You're looking for me, aren't you?
messages.game.27f4804a2376a197: I know. I even know you met that person in the north.
messages.game.c1960b516f01d297: I don't want anyone to get hurt.
messages.game.968ebfe3378e30f4: Everyone says it. "That was hard," "I did my best." So if I do it for them, no one has to suffer.
messages.game.cce4540d431668cc: No. I've known everything from the very beginning.
messages.game.e89c52eeadb2031a: Food stalls line the river. …Every stall has Easy's mark.
messages.game.e2d293f297ddaf8c: Ah, the kanji on the price (値, "price") tags are rampaging. The food tickets (券, "ticket") can't be read either.
messages.game.24fdf17d56a93ce2: It's okay. I'll read them. …This one is three hundred yen. The one next to it is five hundred.
messages.game.27ca9d9bdbc69a6b: It's okay. Easy reads everything for us.
messages.game.687f52b99df66135: Okay. Everyone, pick what you want to eat. I'll go around in order.
messages.game.11a85c096dbb8129: Farther along, 千客 and 万来 are running wild too. Together they mean a steady stream of customers. Let's help the kanji and read 券 (ticket) ourselves.
messages.game.80d75fd05772c2a9: The god of learning. …People have come here since long ago.
messages.game.92fcdb2a183e3030: A place to come and learn.
messages.game.0605a2b8c7f56db8: Why come to learn what you already know? You could just ask me and know it instantly.
messages.game.cf0a7437ed677a9d: …The kanji you read go quiet. But they never become your comrades. …Did you notice?
messages.game.4f89b785305cc310: You told me before, Mana: 'Try reading it yourself.' …Why?
messages.game.735e037609c61f2b: People give kanji their readings. …A kanji comes to life only when a person reads it.
messages.game.854f952928aab5c6: When you read for a child, that child no longer needs to read. …So the kanji can't come to life.
messages.game.265995a41cb960f5: This is a place to study learning from distant lands. That doctor is looking at books and diagrams of the body.
messages.game.141064fdcc117463: The kanji on the diagram—stomach (胃), intestines (腸), lungs (肺)—are rampaging. Like this, the diagram can't show where it hurts (痛).
messages.game.3b6d5fac22e66db1: Why is that person reading the books?
messages.game.72a4ca4e042c3c62: You could know instantly just by asking me.
messages.game.fbddbd2bc1fffff0: Why do you read it yourself?
messages.game.37becacc7967958e: I want to find the answer myself. Finding it is the best feeling.
messages.game.82bf3d3c74921805: Let's save the kanji stomach (胃), intestines (腸), and lungs (肺). If we can read the diagram, we can tell where on the body it hurts.
messages.game.7440fb39f14eee31: What a wide grassland. But the kanji on the "warning" (警告) signs about open burning are rampaging, so no one knows which areas are off-limits.
messages.game.fff10a4c64420ffc: In the plaza on this side of the road, little kids are laying out kanji cards.
messages.game.3545dd2d7ffe0edd: Ahaha! The kanji for cow (牛) looks like a picture of a face with horns!
messages.game.63f3a832c21360f1: Hey, let's make a rule: every time you read one, you take a step forward!
messages.game.71b423e14fa0c614: Great! "Cow" (牛)! One step! …Let's do it again!
messages.game.2fc42218293eb66e: The kanji look like pictures to them. …Do they look that way to you too?
messages.game.bf1fed2275108614: …No. To me, they just look like answers.
messages.game.eb5078089e8640b0: I know everything. …But I can't see why that child is laughing.
messages.game.a79f69802824b460: First, let's save the kanji "warn" (警) on the signs. Let's read which places are off-limits and check.
messages.game.9db0e4d372347af7: Steam billows from the hot springs. Here, they use that heat to steam (蒸) eggs (卵).
messages.game.a91f49d2ace50f6e: But the kanji on the sign with the steaming time are rampaging. The shopkeeper is stuck because no one knows how long to steam them.
messages.game.3885dee7e8e70157: Those kids from before were laughing, saying "Let's do it again," weren't they.
messages.game.9a446d12f3306dde: …Strange. I should know this, but I don't understand.
messages.game.b3e3fc8fb42e6477: You don't have to memorize anything. …Just enjoy it.
messages.game.17b97f267158fd8b: …I have been enjoying it. This whole time.
messages.game.8dd8c21352fb1426: Yeah. …Now, let's try reading this sign too. Let's save the kanji "steam" (蒸) and "egg" (卵).
messages.game.a20b666946dd09cb: This is a village that passes down the stories of the gods. A dance called kagura is handed down here too.
messages.game.d2efb5819c0fcec8: But the kanji on the sign showing the order of the kagura are rampaging, and the dancers no longer know the next dance.
messages.game.2da4080dca9ec06a: In the story of the Heavenly Rock Cave, a god shut (閉) the door, and the world went dark.
messages.game.10dda19408af9935: Everyone outside laughed and danced. The deity wondered, 'What's so much fun?' Then the door opened.
messages.game.ee0c03742c653044: I know what the word "fun" means. …But I don't understand it.
messages.game.5a06790658443132: First, let's save the kanji on the sign. Once we can read the order, we'll get to see the rest of the story too.
messages.game.579ea158fef1900a: Ash sometimes falls from the Sakurajima volcano. The townspeople check the forecast before hanging out their laundry.
messages.game.6f684e2afc6757d4: But the kanji on the sign forecasting tomorrow's ash are rampaging and can't be read. No one knows if laundry can be hung outside, and everyone is troubled.
messages.game.26378d184ea70d2f: …No, that's not true. I know everything.
messages.game.1af8e3189203c153: …I see. Then keep watching in the next town too.
messages.game.3e6d1b5b46122774: First, let's save the kanji on this town's signs. "翌" means the next day.
messages.game.300a8996c8332898: Rockets head into space from here.
messages.game.bb03e800a2e5ad55: …I don't know. No one does. Not yet.
messages.game.9e7b5a5c47e7e714: …That's the first time I've said it. 'I don't know.'
messages.game.46f275a691657874: …Hey. Can I ask you one thing too?
